projects.title: AF7 Apparel Fastener
projects.summary: A complete visual identity and 45-page brand book for a Lahore zipper manufacturer, built on precision.
projects.overview: AF7 makes zippers and fastening components for garment makers and apparel brands. The identity is built around strength, clarity and quiet confidence, so the logo, colour, typography and graphic language work as one voice from a carton label to the company website.
projects.challenge: Industrial suppliers often look generic or dated. AF7 needed to feel as precise as the parts it makes and hold together across factory packaging, workwear, stationery and digital.
projects.solution: A heavy, compact AF7 wordmark with a strict construction grid and clear-space rules, a navy-led palette with steel and mist neutrals, Montserrat and Poppins for type, a zipper-tooth pattern and a line icon set. The guidelines cover packaging on three board types, polybags, workwear, stationery, the website and the app.

projects.title: Corvane
projects.summary: A quiet-luxury identity for a private bank and family office, built on a raven drawn with a compass.
projects.overview: Corvane is a self-initiated concept for a private wealth bank and family office in Lahore, Dubai and London. The project covers the whole identity, from the symbol and its geometry to stationery, a brass client card, a banking app and a brand standards book.
projects.challenge: Private banks tend to look either old and ornate or interchangeable with retail fintech. The goal was an identity as precise as Swiss engineering and as calm as an old banking hall, with a mark that still works at 16 pixels and in one colour.
projects.solution: The symbol is a single initial C that is also a raven in profile, built only from circles and horizontals, with its beak resting on a horizon line that runs through every application. Ledger green, ivory and brushed brass, Cormorant Garamond with Inter, and a measured tone of voice carry it from foil-stamped paper to the app.

projects.title: FANI Coffee
projects.summary: A warm, premium identity for Farhan Shafiq's coffee house: Brewing Good Vibes.
projects.overview: FANI Coffee is a premium coffee house built on warm hospitality. The name comes from the idea of a fan: a person who appreciates, loves and supports. The brand positions FANI as a community of coffee lovers, not just a place to buy a cup.
projects.challenge: The local market already has strong names like Gloria Jean's and well-loved independents. FANI needed a recognisable, premium look that still felt friendly, and a system that could stretch from cups to uniforms, signage, social media and an ordering app.
projects.solution: A steaming-cup mark paired with a confident serif wordmark and the tagline Brewing Good Vibes, in espresso brown, caramel and cream. The system includes horizontal, stacked, emblem and reverse logos, uniforms, drinkware, takeaway packaging, storefront and wall signage, social templates and a mobile app.

projects.title: Ember & Oak
projects.summary: A luxury coffee brand built around slow craft, origin stories and an editorial online shop.
projects.overview: Ember & Oak is a concept specialty-coffee brand shaped around carefully sourced beans and the rituals that make coffee memorable. Warm natural tones, refined typography and an editorial visual language make it feel timeless, tactile and quietly premium.
projects.challenge: Specialty coffee is crowded with near-identical kraft-paper looks. The brief was to signal craft and origin without clichés, and carry that feeling from a bag on the shelf to a product page on a phone.
projects.solution: A flexible mark and an origin-led packaging system where each bean, from Brazil, Colombia and Ethiopia, gets its own character inside one family. The website turns the physical identity into an editorial journey through story, packaging, craft and signature blends.

projects.title: 4K Brew
projects.summary: A warm, modern café identity: Brewed for Perfection. Every sip crafted with joy and served with love.
projects.overview: 4K Brew is a modern coffee brand built around premium quality, refined taste and a warm café experience. The identity combines contemporary design with the authentic character of coffee culture.
projects.challenge: The café needed one identity that could work for coffee, tea and dessert, look premium on a takeaway cup and still feel friendly enough for a neighbourhood café.
projects.solution: A cup-and-beans mark with a spaced BRÉW wordmark, in four versions: abstract, vintage badge, signature script and reverse. Black stands for quality, Bright Sienna for warmth and freshness, and Baker's Chocolate for roasted beans. The system runs across cups, bags, menus, a thank-you card, signage, staff uniforms and social posts, tied together with a hand-drawn leaf pattern.

projects.title: Discover Gilgit Baltistan
projects.summary: A tourism identity for the northern mountains: Explore. Experience. Belong.
projects.overview: Discover Gilgit Baltistan captures the spirit of adventure, natural beauty and rich culture of Pakistan's northern mountains. The brand stands for exploration, belonging and a deep connection with nature.
projects.challenge: A destination brand has to work on a luggage tag, a water bottle and a tiny social icon, and appeal to adventurers and families alike.
projects.solution: A bold gb monogram with the mountain range set into the b, in forest green, olive, sand and off-white. The mark works in light, dark and green versions, as a repeat pattern and as an app icon, with a set of line illustrations for mountains, camping, exploring, photography and adventure.

projects.title: Mono
projects.summary: A monochrome identity system built on typography, structure and restraint.
projects.overview: Mono is a contemporary identity focused on simplicity, structure and recognition, designed to stay consistent across stationery, packaging, signage and social media.
projects.challenge: A minimal identity can easily become anonymous. The challenge was to make restraint recognisable without relying on colour or decoration.
projects.solution: A constructed mark on a precise grid, a black, white and red palette, typography that balances personality with clarity, and guidelines that run naturally from business cards to billboards.

projects.title: Noorah
projects.summary: A character-led lifestyle identity that turns a personality into a complete content system.
projects.overview: Noorah is a playful mascot identity that gives a lifestyle brand a recognisable personality, visual voice and emotional connection across beauty, fashion and self-care content.
projects.challenge: Creator brands need to feel personal while staying consistent across hundreds of posts, thumbnails and products.
projects.solution: An expressive character mark, a soft but refined visual language, photography direction, social and YouTube templates, and merchandise: a system that lets the personality scale.

projects.title: Open After Hours
projects.summary: WA Creative Solution's own social launch campaign, built around a line every shop owner knows.
projects.overview: An in-house social campaign for Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn. The idea is simple: a shop closes at night, a good website doesn't. It runs as a template system of feed posts, carousels, stories and link ads, built around four content pillars.
projects.challenge: Small businesses scroll past agency ads about digital transformation. The campaign had to sound like the people it is for, show real proof instead of claims, and be easy to produce every week.
projects.solution: A Roman Urdu hook, "Dukaan raat ko band hoti hai. Website nahi.", with plain English underneath. Four pillars rotate through the feed: real work, checklists owners save, process steps and local moments like Eid. Every format shares one grid, corner marks, Montserrat headlines and a single red word.
